item.title: Archival Resource Key (Ark) Alliance
item.description:
📝 3 billion ARKs have been created by over 1700 organizations — libraries, data centers, archives, museums, publishers, government agencies, and vendors. ARKs are open, mainstream, non-paywalled, decentralized persistent identifiers that you can start creating in under 48 hours. ARKs are similar to DOIs, URNs, and Handles.
🔗 Read more: https://arks.org/
